name: Omathor for THORChain
author: sette7blo
description: THORChain from the Omarchy bar: one bolt, coloured by how the network and your nodes are doing. Six tabs: network health, the next churn (halts respected), security and upgrades; your bonds per node with share, earnings, APY and churn-out risk; THORNames with expiry and pending affiliate fees; node votes on mimir; pools with depth, volume and APR; and connected chains. Read-only, no key or account. Each bond address is sent only once, to look up its THORNames.

barWidget.description: A bolt coloured by THORChain's health and your bonded nodes, with a panel for the network, bonds, THORNames, votes, pools and chains.
